Native GFx sends Press_Continue, but its C++ sink and exact process-exit/IPC linkage are not qualified. The AIR stopped/crashed/abandoned handlers are separate verified definitions.

InGameController.deactivate compares currentState==connected then discards the result (AVM2 equals/pop), not a reset assignment. Preserve this original source behavior.

Current Rust process state playing is not proof of transport/asset/graphical readiness; failed-exit errors take precedence over the reconnecting label while can_resume may remain true.
